description: Use when a Bats helper, stub or fixture in `tests/bats/` has been edited and the change is about to be staged. Symptoms include a filtered `bats -f "pattern"` run passing while the full suite fails, a helper name defined twice in one file, and a ShellCheck `SC2329` unreachable-function warning on the first of the two definitions.
